channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: Reverse engineering with AI: the browser already handed you the source
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An agent can read any website's minified code faster than you can open DevTools. Three real teardowns we did, what an AI read out of our own tracker, and an honest test of doing it on open models on c0mpute.

item.title: I’m a 1000x engineer now
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A startup used to need $2M, six engineers and two years to ship a product. Last Saturday I shipped one before dinner. Here are the real numbers, how the work actually runs, and what it costs.

item.title: A US bank account for everyone who isn’t American
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A teammate in Nigeria gets paid in dollars through a consumer app that only works for one corridor. We are building the same thing into CoinPay for every country we can, without ever holding anyone's money.

item.title: I am now a button pusher
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An AI agent closed six issues, shipped three releases and fixed checkout while I clicked a CAPTCHA. The typing is gone. Knowing whether to push the button is the job now, and that comes from scar tissue.

item.title: Post-mortem: how an attacker got a shell through our Postgres
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A leaked SSH key, a Docker port that skipped the firewall, and a lockdown that did not survive a reboot. What happened on one of our build boxes and what we changed.

item.title: Software Engineering in the Agentic Era is on Gumroad
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Software Engineering in the Agentic Era is now a Gumroad download: PDF, EPUB, HTML and Markdown, pay what you want from $5.

item.title: How visible is YC’s Fall 2026 batch to AI search?
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: We audited all 235 YC Fall 2026 companies with websites for AI-search visibility. Median score 46/100, nobody above 63.

item.title: c0mpute nodes now charge AI crawlers for the files they host
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: c0mpute nodes sell day passes to AI training crawlers over x402, paid through CoinPay to the operator's own wallet, plus ThreatCrush on every node and a CoinPay key-scope audit.

item.title: Join the revolution: your spare box can be a c0mpute node
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: c0mpute pools spare CPUs and GPUs from ordinary machines into one open network. One command turns your box into a node that serves inference, transcoding and storage jobs. Here is why that matters and what a node does today.

item.title: Inference on Infernet is pay as you go, and the price follows the market
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Interactive inference now spends the same prepaid balance paid batches use, node earnings can pay for your own compute, and the price of a model moves with how busy the nodes serving it are.
